name: RC-B10-0577/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the kidnapping of 303 students and 12 teachers from St Mary's Catholic School in Papiri, Nigeria, on 21 November 2025. It condemns the attack and all attacks on children and schools. It demands the immediate release of everyone still held and asks Nigeria's government to protect schools, investigate the abductions and bring those responsible to justice.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament asks Nigeria to free all remaining captives and protect schools.
- **Who it affects:** The kidnapped children and teachers, their families, and children in northern and central Nigeria.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends its position to the European Commission, the Council, the European Union's foreign policy chief, and Nigeria's government and parliament.
